verdict.rationale: Drata has a Policy Center, and its API documents creating policies plus listing and creating policy versions, so policy authoring and versioning are evidenced. The pack shows no lawyer-grade template library, editor UX, approval workflow, or per-employee acceptance tracking. The Policy Center item is only a title, and the Personnel API items never mention policy acceptance. Missing for 10: evidence of a lawyer-grade template library, an in-app policy editor, approval workflows, per-employee acceptance tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
